author: txkingg
quote: So disappointed. I fell in love with the franchise due to the freedom of doing anything I wanted. It was a true video game, escape from reality. Throughout the serious they introduce a freedom of choice, with story consequences. Now they take a way that choice and the choices they do give you are dumb. Where are all the features that made gta gta? You could literally steal any car and shoot any npc in the video. Now there is protected npcs? Where is the multiple gf feature that existed in gta 4? That would have added to the story. The main characters are so boring. We went from 3 wild character with their own unique personality, to two soulless npcs.
